001package org.clafer.frontend;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.List;
006
007/**
008 * Splits the explicit form of a Clafer model, as {@link org.clafer.ast.AstPrinter}
009 * prints it, into tokens.
010 * <p>
011 * Whitespace and line breaks only separate tokens: nesting is in braces, and
012 * indentation carries no meaning. Comments ({@code // ...} to the end of the
013 * line and {@code /* ... *}{@code /}) are set aside with their spans, for
014 * tools that show or keep them.
015 * <p>
016 * Lines and columns start at 1. A column counts UTF-16 code units, as the
017 * Language Server Protocol does by default, so a tab is one column. A span
018 * ends after its last character.
019 * <p>
020 * The lexer does not stop at an error: an unexpected character or an
021 * unterminated string becomes an {@link TokenKind#ERROR} token with a
022 * diagnostic, and lexing goes on after it.
023 */
024public final class Lexer {
025
026    /**
027     * The operators and punctuation, longest first so that the longest match
028     * wins, e.g., {@code ->>} over {@code ->}.
029     */
030    private static final String[] Symbols = {
031        "-->>", "]->>",
032        "<=>", "->>", "-->", "]->",
033        "<<", ">>", "->", "-[", ":=", "..", "::", "<=", ">=", "!=", "&&", "||", "=>",
034        "++", "--", "**", "<:", ":>", "*.", "/.",
035        ".", ":", "[", "]", "(", ")", "{", "}", ",", ";", "|",
036        "<", ">", "=", "!", "#", "+", "-", "*", "/", "%", "~", "^"
037    };
038
039    /**
040     * The tokens of a source text.
041     *
042     * @param tokens the tokens for the parser, ending with
043     * {@link TokenKind#EOF}
044     * @param comments the comments, in order
045     * @param diagnostics the errors, in order
046     */
047    public record Result(List<Token> tokens, List<Token> comments, List<Diagnostic> diagnostics) {
048    }
049
050    private final String source;
051    private int pos = 0;
052    private int line = 1;
053    private int column = 1;
054    private final List<Token> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
055    private final List<Token> comments = new ArrayList<>();
056    private final List<Diagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
057
058    private Lexer(String source) {
059        this.source = source;
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Splits a source text into tokens.
064     *
065     * @param source the source text
066     * @return the tokens, the comments and the errors
067     */
068    public static Result lex(String source) {
069        Lexer lexer = new Lexer(source);
070        lexer.run();
071        return new Result(
072                Collections.unmodifiableList(lexer.tokens),
073                Collections.unmodifiableList(lexer.comments),
074                Collections.unmodifiableList(lexer.diagnostics));
075    }
076
077    private void run() {
078        while (pos < source.length()) {
079            char c = source.charAt(pos);
080            if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f') {
081                advance();
082            } else if (source.startsWith("//", pos)) {
083                lineComment();
084            } else if (source.startsWith("/*", pos)) {
085                blockComment();
086            } else if (isWordStart(c)) {
087                word();
088            } else if (isDigit(c)) {
089                number();
090            } else if (c == '"') {
091                string();
092            } else {
093                symbol();
094            }
095        }
096        tokens.add(new Token(TokenKind.EOF, "", new SourceSpan(line, column, line, column)));
097    }
098
099    private static boolean isWordStart(char c) {
100        return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || c == '_';
101    }
102
103    private static boolean isWordPart(char c) {
104        return isWordStart(c) || isDigit(c) || c == '\'';
105    }
106
107    private static boolean isDigit(char c) {
108        return c >= '0' && c <= '9';
109    }
110
111    private char peek(int offset) {
112        int i = pos + offset;
113        return i < source.length() ? source.charAt(i) : '\0';
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * Moves past one character, counting a line break (LF, CRLF or CR) once.
118     */
119    private void advance() {
120        char c = source.charAt(pos++);
121        if (c == '\n' || (c == '\r' && peek(0) != '\n')) {
122            line++;
123            column = 1;
124        } else if (c != '\r') {
125            column++;
126        }
127    }
128
129    private Token emit(List<Token> into, TokenKind kind, int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {
130        Token token = new Token(kind, source.substring(startPos, pos),
131                new SourceSpan(startLine, startColumn, line, column));
132        into.add(token);
133        return token;
134    }
135
136    private void lineComment() {
137        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
138        while (pos < source.length() && source.charAt(pos) != '\n' && source.charAt(pos) != '\r') {
139            advance();
140        }
141        emit(comments, TokenKind.COMMENT, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
142    }
143
144    private void blockComment() {
145        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
146        advance();
147        advance();
148        while (pos < source.length() && !source.startsWith("*/", pos)) {
149            advance();
150        }
151        if (pos < source.length()) {
152            advance();
153            advance();
154            emit(comments, TokenKind.COMMENT, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
155        } else {
156            Token error = emit(tokens, TokenKind.ERROR, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
157            diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(error.span(), "Unterminated comment"));
158        }
159    }
160
161    private void word() {
162        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
163        while (pos < source.length() && isWordPart(source.charAt(pos))) {
164            advance();
165        }
166        emit(tokens, TokenKind.WORD, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
167    }
168
169    /**
170     * An integer, or a decimal if a point and a digit follow the digits, so
171     * that {@code 1..2} is a range of integers.
172     */
173    private void number() {
174        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
175        while (pos < source.length() && isDigit(source.charAt(pos))) {
176            advance();
177        }
178        TokenKind kind = TokenKind.INT;
179        if (peek(0) == '.' && isDigit(peek(1))) {
180            kind = TokenKind.DECIMAL;
181            advance();
182            while (pos < source.length() && isDigit(source.charAt(pos))) {
183                advance();
184            }
185            // a double, with its exponent, e.g., 1.2e2 or 1.0e-2
186            int sign = peek(1) == '-' ? 1 : 0;
187            if (peek(0) == 'e' && isDigit(peek(1 + sign))) {
188                kind = TokenKind.DOUBLE;
189                for (int i = 0; i <= sign; i++) {
190                    advance();
191                }
192                while (pos < source.length() && isDigit(source.charAt(pos))) {
193                    advance();
194                }
195            }
196        }
197        emit(tokens, kind, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
198    }
199
200    /**
201     * A string on one line. The escapes are checked here, and
202     * {@link #unescape} decodes them.
203     */
204    private void string() {
205        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
206        advance();
207        while (pos < source.length()) {
208            char c = source.charAt(pos);
209            if (c == '"') {
210                advance();
211                emit(tokens, TokenKind.STRING, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
212                return;
213            }
214            if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
215                break;
216            }
217            if (c == '\\') {
218                int escapeLine = line, escapeColumn = column;
219                advance();
220                int length = escapeLength(peek(0), pos);
221                if (length == 0) {
222                    // Report the backslash and the character after it, unless
223                    // that ends the string or the line, and go on.
224                    char next = peek(0);
225                    if (pos < source.length() && next != '"' && next != '\n' && next != '\r') {
226                        advance();
227                    }
228                    diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(new SourceSpan(escapeLine, escapeColumn, line, column),
229                            "Unknown escape in a string; use \\\", \\\\, \\n, \\t or \\uXXXX"));
230                }
231                for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
232                    advance();
233                }
234            } else {
235                advance();
236            }
237        }
238        Token error = emit(tokens, TokenKind.ERROR, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
239        diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(error.span(), "Unterminated string"));
240    }
241
242    /**
243     * @return how many characters after the backslash the escape takes, or 0
244     * if it is not one
245     */
246    private int escapeLength(char c, int at) {
247        switch (c) {
248            case '"', '\\', 'n', 't' -> {
249                return 1;
250            }
251            case 'u' -> {
252                for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
253                    int j = at + i;
254                    if (j >= source.length() || Character.digit(source.charAt(j), 16) < 0) {
255                        return 0;
256                    }
257                }
258                return 5;
259            }
260            default -> {
261                return 0;
262            }
263        }
264    }
265
266    private void symbol() {
267        int startPos = pos, startLine = line, startColumn = column;
268        for (String symbol : Symbols) {
269            if (source.startsWith(symbol, pos)) {
270                for (int i = 0; i < symbol.length(); i++) {
271                    advance();
272                }
273                emit(tokens, TokenKind.SYMBOL, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
274                return;
275            }
276        }
277        advance();
278        Token error = emit(tokens, TokenKind.ERROR, startPos, startLine, startColumn);
279        diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(error.span(), "Unexpected character " + describe(error.text().charAt(0))));
280    }
281
282    private static String describe(char c) {
283        return c >= ' ' && c <= '~' ? "'" + c + "'" : String.format("U+%04X", (int) c);
284    }
285
286    /**
287     * Decodes a string token: drops the quotes and replaces the escapes.
288     *
289     * @param token the text of a {@link TokenKind#STRING} token
290     * @return the string it denotes
291     */
292    public static String unescape(String token) {
293        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
294        for (int i = 1; i < token.length() - 1; i++) {
295            char c = token.charAt(i);
296            if (c != '\\') {
297                out.append(c);
298                continue;
299            }
300            char e = token.charAt(++i);
301            switch (e) {
302                case 'n' -> out.append('\n');
303                case 't' -> out.append('\t');
304                case 'u' -> {
305                    out.append((char) Integer.parseInt(token.substring(i + 1, i + 5), 16));
306                    i += 4;
307                }
308                default -> out.append(e);
309            }
310        }
311        return out.toString();
312    }
313}
